$description: Declared pairs for the WCAG 2.x contrast check (tool/contrast-check.mjs). fg and bg are role names (color.theme.<theme>.<role>, with theme) or full token paths. kind: text 4.5, large-text 3, boundary 3, decoration (no threshold unless min is set). expect: the ratio, rounded to 2 decimals, that must be reproduced. assertFail: the pair must fail its threshold (a rejected option, proving a rule). min overrides the threshold.
